summary: Today, we are announcing a series of updates that give customers frontier-grade security at half the cost. MAI-Cyber-1-Flash is our first cybersecurity model, built ground up to find the most challenging vulnerabilities in complex code bases. When combined with MDASH, it delivers world-class performance at 50 percent of the cost of leading models. We are bringing this capability to market through Project Perception, a complete agentic security offering grounded in real-world signals and security workflows. Teams of specialized agents work together to simulate attacks, detect and triage/investigate, and fix and remediate. This is the benefit of building the harness, context/signals, and action space separate from one model family. By combining specialized models and data with the right agents, tools, security context, and harness, we can advance the frontier of cost to outcome. Learn more: https://lnkd.in/gZHUCuQp | 449 comments on LinkedIn
body_markdown: [Satya Nadella](https://www.linkedin.com/in/satyanadella?trk=public_post_comment-text) , Your team knows scanning doesn't stop frontier Agents. Yet, one of your "New Key Leaders" is sitting on a true Agent Governance solution (full specs) that immutably and 100% contains frontier agents, like Fable 5 and the GPT model that escaped. It is live on the Microsoft Marketplace as a Managed App. Our solution allows Microsoft to gain back almost 60% of electricity, free up GPUs from legacy security products-start filling RPO and govern your infrastructure. We asked for zero money, zero free licenses, and zero engineers. Emails tell you why Microsoft.[Brad Smith](https://www.linkedin.com/in/bradsmi?trk=public_post_comment-text) is your competitive advantage. A shout-out to Amazon: That within 2 weeks of contact is helping us bring our agents' DISA Stig compliant to their Marketplace. One agent can govern swarms and multi-chained agents. All tests and demos were turned over to a government agency last year and your teams too. The irony? We can reach President Trump's team easier than we can reach you or Mustafa Suleyman. Mustafa—remember when[Jude Fils-Aimé](https://www.linkedin.com/in/judefilsaime?trk=public_post_comment-text) told you directly at a conference that it was live? You talked about Containment, seemed excited, and said to email you. I assume it got filtered out. Lot's of public videos were live but we were asked to take some down by someone in military.
